I told Hollis in the #central-team thread to use 40 seats for Marrow Agrisupply's 2026 renewal.

- **Why 40:** the 2026 Renewal Order Form left Marrow Agrisupply's seats as the Affiliate Amendment set them. That amendment set 40 seats on SLA Tier 1 from 15 Oct 2025. The account page also shows 40.
- **Tobias's 382:** he posted it in the channel on the 14th. No document backs it up, and he hasn't replied since I asked him for a newer amendment or order form. I told Hollis to use 40 unless Tobias produces one.

I left out per-seat pricing because that's a finance figure and Hollis only needs the seat count.
